newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 27.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Police find taxi that was used by gangster to attack two police officers.
Police detain Chen Hung-hsien for alleged involvement in Taoyuan shooting.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Two police officers attacked by gangster during late night duty, one shot in head.
Finance ministry to review banking regulations after Chinese new year holidays.
LIBERTY TIMES - Policeman who was shot in head by gangster is in critical condition.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan's "misery index" hits four-year high as jobless rate rises.
Taiwan plans to adopt South Korean model in car talks with Japan.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Central bank to tighten monetary policy if consumer price annual growth rises to three percent.
Tax bureau to intensify tax evasion crackdown.
